articles.title: 11-Year-Old Bodhana Makes Chess History
articles.summary: On September 26, 2026, 11-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan became the youngest person ever to earn the Woman Grandmaster chess title.

articles.title: WoW: Forever Wraps the Biggest Beta in Franchise History
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever just wrapped the largest beta in the game's history, with over a million characters created, ahead of its November 4 launch.

articles.title: AI Movies Flop in Theaters, Even as AI Videos Flood Phones
articles.summary: A fully AI-generated film flopped in Chinese theaters despite two years of work by 70 to 80 people, showing audiences still expect more from a theater ticket than from free phone videos.
